slots.name: Senate approval threshold
slots.sentence: After the committee vote, Blanche would still need to be approved by the full Senate with at least 50 votes.

slots.name: Committee composition
slots.sentence: Cornyn and Tillis are key swing votes on the committee, which consists of 12 Republicans and 10 Democrats.

slots.name: Senate party majority
slots.sentence: Republicans hold a 53-47 majority in the chamber, which has been winnowed to 52 by the extended absence of Sen. Mitch McConnell, R-Ky., who hasn't returned to the Senate since a fall in June.

slots.name: Fund status
slots.sentence: Despite Blanche's written assurance that the fund is dead, Trump's attorneys continue to fight in court against a judicial order that blasted the settlement deal as legally baseless.

slots.name: IRS settlement amount
slots.sentence: The documents Blanche posted late Sunday showed Blanche had formally rescinded the order that created the fund in May, while clarifying aspects of the May settlement of Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against the Internal Revenue Service that created the fund.

slots.name: fund amount
slots.sentence: Cornyn and Tillis demanded a written commitment ending Trump’s proposed $1.8 billion anti-weaponization fund as the price for their support.

slots.name: confirmation status
slots.sentence: Every Democrat, along with Republicans Susan Collins (Maine) and Lisa Murkowski (Alaska), opposed Blanche.
